errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents the criteria, while the vertical axis represents the number of participants.
errors.evidence: The figure shows the criteria on the vertical axis and the number of participants on the horizontal axis, not the other way around.

The description does not mention the specific colors used to differentiate the criteria (e.g., dark purple, dark blue, teal, light teal, light green).
